verdicts.reason: The report uses stored expected constants instead of reading the game, and it misses a changed health value. Both are listed false passes or red outcomes.
The sky must give lightning without rain. A supposed dry storm that rains is the leaf's red outcome.
The untouched site shows mineral flora and fauna, distinguishable wet dark plain and rich soil, and rainless lightning. All five weather states are distinct.
A hazardous pool that corrodes apparel but pumps out fresh water is the explicit false pass. Transferred hazard must not silently become fresh water.
The cue starts after harmful exposure, which is the red outcome. Cues must come about one hour before bloom.

The vent lull and eligible idle-native stillness come about 2500 ticks before bloom without the optional message. The sleeping native is correctly excluded, and the worker reaches shelter before the dose.
A fully sealed worker takes an ambient metal dose. Item survival cannot imply wearer protection.
The exposed control is affected and the roofed and fully sealed workers keep their starting health. The partial-equipment result follows its rule.
Slow natural decay labelled 'permanent' is the explicit false pass. Metal must not clear on its own.
A low saved trace is purged through a normal health bill, with operation completion and advanced-medicine consumption.
All acid effects heal away and Sight is restored, which is the red outcome.
A completed harvest pays no metal, and the assay grade does not match the payout.
Three seed-bearing bound kin rooted a young thornwood while resting. The galled animal binds, drops edible galls and remains seedless.
A shot suush that dies without a toxic burst is the red outcome. Ranged hits must start a toxic detonation.
Lined taps must resist prying. Pry damage to a lined tap is the red outcome.
Wild drinking suppresses and then recovers output. Tame shearing supplies vexxith without killing the animal.
Sealed diagonal barriers must stop the chain. Leaking through a sealed corner is the red outcome.
A dramatic blast that throws none of the identified goods is the red outcome.
Work must pause without losing stock when power is missing. Input vanished silently.
All-off must not destroy stock or cure lasting health. Erasing poisoned pawns or banked liquids is the explicit false pass.
Prepared workers complete routine work with no new ambient injury and a reconciled ledger. Expedition and vexxiss danger remain attributable.
Reload loses grove bindings, which is the red outcome.
Poisoning self-clears without advanced treatment. Calling it 'persistent' is a slow-decay false pass.
Sensory capacity returns to baseline. A cosmetic scar without lasting sensory harm fails, and a supposed permanent sensory injury that restores capacity is the red outcome.
The visible vent and animal cues must give about one hour of warning. The optional message only supplements those cues and cannot substitute for them.
Roof protection works for only one ambient route, since the roofed worker still takes acid burns. This is the red outcome.
Straight or diagonal sealed barriers must stop the chain. Leaking through a sealed corner is the red outcome.
Destroying goods and respawning them elsewhere with new ids is the explicit false pass. Identified goods must be thrown.
All-off must not cure lasting health. The poisoning was erased.
Metal must be growth-scaled and follow the assay grade. The young and mature trees paid the same 12 steel despite different grades.

ambiguities: c08: the 12 steel figure is candidate tuning for full growth only. The rejection rests on the absence of growth scaling, not on the number itself.
